objective: Test whether the remaining scalar interaction information is captured by residual/column incidence topology with only immediate-frontier status and positive release-depth parity.

candidate.name: TOPO_RPAR
candidate.definition: Canonical owner-preserving residual/column incidence hypergraph with each residual cell labeled F when depth=0, O when depth is positive odd, and E when depth is positive even.
structural_motivation: Depth 0 is uniquely immediately playable under gravity.
For delayed cells, release-depth parity is the minimal turn-parity signal suggested by EW-RS-041.
EW-RS-041 shows TOPO_DPAR is already scalar-exact on 6x3-k3 while TOPO_D012 leaves only 12 scalar contradictions on 4x4-k4.
On 4x4-k4, TOPO_D012 loses only the distinction between depths 2 and 3; TOPO_RPAR restores that distinction while deliberately continuing to merge depths 1 and 3.

anti_circularity: TOPO_RPAR is fixed before outcome qualification.
Its labels depend only on current frontier-relative gravity depth and residual incidence.
No W/D/L label, fitted coefficient, contradiction key, or oracle outcome selects the candidate.
falsifiers: Any scalar contradiction rejects TOPO_RPAR on that carrier.
REL_INC_EXACT and REL_INC must remain scalar-exact controls.
Exact component identity must reproduce the full observed degree-2 structural rank.
next_if_success: Freeze TOPO_RPAR as the current compact scalar interaction coordinate, then qualify the unchanged coordinate on a predeclared fresh non-affine holdout before attempting direct two-syndrome coefficient derivation.
next_if_fail: Preserve the exact contradiction family and test the next structurally motivated refinement inside release timing/topology; do not add outcome-selected arbitrary features.
